HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD ?Court No. - 79 Case :- CRIMINAL MISC. BAIL APPLICATION No. - 16521 of 2023 Applicant :- Sushil Kumar Rajbhar @ Sushil Opposite Party :- State Of U.P.And Another Counsel for Applicant :- Ajay Kumar Srivastava

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mayank Kumar Jain,J.
Supplementary affidavit filed on behalf of applicant is taken on record.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The present bail application has been filed on behalf of applicant in Case Crime No. 524 of 2022,
under Sections 376, 323, 506 IPC, Police Station Badagaon, District Varanasi with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.
It is further submitted that victim, who was 20 years of age at the time of incident, accompanied the applicant at her own accord and she was a consenting party.

It is further submitted that victim performed marriage on 12.11.2021 with the applicant at Sarang Nath Old Shiv Mandir, Varanasi on her own sweet will and she remained with the applicant from 12.11.2021 to 22.12.2022.
It is further submitted that informant's father had taken money from the father of the applicant and when his father asked to return money, the present F.I.R. has been lodged against the applicant.

It is further submitted that no external or internal injury seen during Sushil Kumar Rajbhar @ Sushil vs State Of U.P.And Another on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40587872/
1 her medical examination.

sentences.text:
It is further submitted that in supplementary medical report of the victim,
no definite opinion about sexual assault has been given.
It is further submitted that applicant is ready to keep the victim with him as his wife.

It is further submitted that applicant is languishing in jail since 23.01.2023 having no criminal history and that in case he is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will cooperate in trial.
Per contra, the learned Additional Government Advocate has opposed the prayer for grant of bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspect of the matter.

Considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case, submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of evidence, all attending facts and circumstances of the case and the fact that victim was consenting party and applicant is ready to keep her as his wife, without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant Sushil Kumar Rajbhar @ Sushil in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned subject to the following conditions:
(1). The applicant will not tamper with the prosecution evidence during the trial.
(2).
The applicant will not influence any witness.
(3). The applicant will appear before the trial Court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

(4). The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move an application before this Court seeking cancellation of the bail.
